description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Perforce (P4) lock mechanisms within a git-p4 integration environment. It contains setup commands, test cases, and functions to simulate and verify locking behavior, including interactions with external P4 clients and depot operations.

methods.name: lock_in_another_client
methods.description: Creates a separate P4 client workspace and opens a file for editing to simulate an external lock on a file.
